modules.title: Introduction to Fahimta da Rubutu (Comprehension and Composition)
modules.html:
Hausa reading comprehension, essay writing and translation. This section covers introduction to fahimta da rubutu (comprehension and composition).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of fahimta da rubutu (comprehension and composition).
  • Be able to explain fahimta da rubutu (comprehension and composition) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: A wanne bangare na sauti ake samun 'Gamasauti' (Diphthongs)?
A: Wasali — Diphthongs are a combination of two vowel sounds within the same syllable, hence they belong to the 'Wasali' (Vowel) category.

Q: Cika gibin: 'Bello _____ Kano jiya.'
A: ya tafi — Since 'Bello' is a singular male subject and the time is past (jiya), the correct marker is 'ya tafi'.

examples.q: A wanne bangare na sauti ake samun 'Gamasauti' (Diphthongs)?

quiz.q: A wanne bangare na sauti ake samun 'Gamasauti' (Diphthongs)?
quiz.solution: Diphthongs are a combination of two vowel sounds within the same syllable, hence they belong to the 'Wasali' (Vowel) category.

quiz.q: Cika gibin: 'Bello _____ Kano jiya.'
quiz.solution: Since 'Bello' is a singular male subject and the time is past (jiya), the correct marker is 'ya tafi'.

quiz.q: Wanne ne sifa (Adjective) a cikin wannan jimlar: 'Ina son riga fara'?
quiz.solution: 'Fara' (white) describes the noun 'riga', making it an adjective (sifa).

quiz.q: Wanne ne wasalin nan 'i'?
quiz.solution: The vowel 'i' is classified as a front vowel (wasali na gaba) in Hausa phonology.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Wakar Gargajiya'?
quiz.solution: 'Wakar Gargajiya' refers to indigenous traditional songs often accompanied by local instruments.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Ami' (Tones) a cikin Hausa?
quiz.solution: Hausa is a tonal language where 'Ami' indicates the high, low, or falling pitch of a syllable.

quiz.q: Cika wannan: 'Ina _____ zuwa gida.'
quiz.solution: The correct construction for 'I want' is 'Ina son' before a verb phrase.

quiz.q: Wanene ya kera wannan: 'Sarkin ruwa'?
quiz.solution: The title 'Sarkin Ruwa' is given to the head of the fishermen community.

quiz.q: Mene ne jam'i (plural) na kalmar 'Littafi'?
quiz.solution: 'Littattafai' is the grammatically correct plural form of 'Littafi'.

quiz.q: Wanne bangare ne na Sauti ake kira 'Diftong' (Diphthong)?
quiz.solution: Diphthongs are known as 'Gamasauti' in Hausa phonetics.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Kirari'?
quiz.solution: Kirari is an epithet or praise-chant used to identify or exalt someone.
